description: ITER-1 FIND-004 only partially addressed. §1 (line 45-47) still states as part of a 'verified 2026-07-03' landscape verdict that 'Anicca is *positioned* first on (b) [public real-time P&L] and (d) [profit redistributed to humans as UBI]' — a hedge clause was added ('a claim we EARN only once a real surplus exists (today: $0, see §0)') but the sentence still asserts the 'first' positioning as a present-tense, verified fact rather than an aspirational target. Criterion (d) is specifically 'profit redistributed to humans as UBI' — with $0 verified profit (§7, line 286-288: 'verified external income across ALL instances = $0') there has been zero redistribution, so 'positioned first' on a redistribution axis with nothing yet redistributed remains an unearned claim dressed as verified status, just with a footnote attached instead of being removed or moved to a target/roadmap framing.

evidence.snippet: Anicca is *positioned* first on (b) and (d) — a claim we EARN only once a real surplus exists (today: $0, see §0) ... [vs] verified external income across ALL instances = $0
